name: Nivolumab Monotherapy (CheckMate-141), Platinum-Refractory Recurrent or Metastatic Head and Neck Squamous Cell Carcinoma
cyclesNote: until disease progression or unacceptable toxicity; alternate schedule 480 mg every 28 days

source.nccn: Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Head and Neck Cancers
source.textbook: Harrison's Principles of Internal Medicine, 22nd ed.

institution.provenance: ONCQIS grounded Standard Protocol (experimental, owner/device test only; not clinically activated)

biomarkers.PD_L1: not required for eligibility; greater overall survival benefit observed when PD-L1 expression level is at least 1%
biomarkers.note: Per Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Head and Neck Cancers v2.2026 Discussion MS-59, the OS benefit with nivolumab appeared confined to patients with PD-L1 expression at least 1% (8.7 vs 4.6 months), with no OS advantage demonstrated below 1%; nivolumab is listed as a subsequent-line option (SYST-A 4 of 7) without a mandatory PD-L1 threshold for use. PD-L1 testing informs expected benefit but is not an eligibility gate here.

supportiveCare: Immune-related adverse event surveillance for nivolumab (thyroid, hepatic, pulmonary, colitis, dermatologic, endocrine).
Antiemetic prophylaxis not routinely required for single-agent checkpoint inhibitor (minimal emetic risk).
monitoring: immune-related toxicity screen (TSH/free T4, LFTs, glucose, cortisol as indicated) during nivolumab
imaging every 2 to 3 cycles in the recurrent/metastatic setting (Standard Guidelines (NCCN) v2.2026, SYST-A 1 of 7 general principles)

doseModificationRules.condition: grade 2 or higher immune-related adverse event
doseModificationRules.text: Hold nivolumab and manage with corticosteroids per immune-related adverse event guidance; obtain clinical review before rechallenge.

drugs.name: Nivolumab
drugs.notes: Source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN) v2.2026, Discussion MS-59. Nivolumab 240 mg IV flat dose on day 1 every 14 days. Source-stated alternate schedule: 480 mg IV every 28 days. Flat milligram dosing (basis flat); source states flat mg, not mg/kg. Continue until disease progression or unacceptable toxicity. A nivolumab and hyaluronidase-nvhy subcutaneous formulation may be substituted with different dosing/administration (SYST-A 1 of 7); not encoded here.

provenance.source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Head and Neck Cancers
provenance.locator: Discussion MS-59 (two FDA-approved dosing regimens for nivolumab for SCCHN: 240 mg every 2 weeks or 480 mg every 4 weeks); indication SYST-A 4 of 7 (subsequent-line, post-platinum, category 1)
